seo.title: Company
seo.seo_title: Nexora: AI for Quebec small businesses
seo.seo_description: Nexora designs, installs and supports AI systems for Quebec small businesses. Our principles: truth first, control, reversibility, one case at a time.

blocks.role: Présentation de Nexora, limitée à ce qui est connu.

translation.headline: Nexora. AI in the service of local small business.
translation.subheadline: Nexora is a Quebec company. We design, install, integrate and support AI systems fitted to your trade, for businesses that want to keep control of their data.

blocks.role: Ce que fait Nexora : quatre verbes.

translation.title: What we do.
translation.body: We start with one concrete problem, then extend the system without multiplying disconnected tools. Two installation modes structure the offer: on your premises, or in our infrastructure in Quebec.

items.title: Design.
items.text: AI systems fitted to your trade, not a catalogue of gadgets.

items.title: Install.
items.text: On your server, or in our infrastructure in Quebec.

items.title: Integrate.
items.text: By connecting the software you already use.

items.title: Support.
items.text: By running the system with you and training your team in usage and supervision.

cards.title: Truth first.
cards.text: We publish no testimonial, no figure and no certification that we cannot prove. When a capability is in pilot or planned, we write it.

cards.title: Control, within the flows we configure.
cards.text: In the workflows we set up, any action that commits the business waits for a person's approval, unless you decide otherwise in writing.

cards.title: Reversibility.
cards.text: Your documents, configurations and workflows stay exportable, and the contract provides for it.

cards.title: One case at a time.
cards.text: One concrete problem, put into service and verified, before expanding. No universal timeline is announced.

blocks.role: Ce que le lecteur peut vérifier.

translation.title: What you can verify.
translation.body: A company is judged by what it lets you check. Here is where to look.

items.title: A status for every capability.
items.text: Each product and each department shows whether it is available, in pilot or planned, for example on the OPSYS-AI page.

items.title: A register of proofs.
items.text: The sensitive claims on this site are kept in an internal register, with their evidence, source and version.

items.title: Documents on request.
items.text: The trust center lists the documents we are preparing and their status.

blocks.role: Joindre Nexora : le formulaire, rien d'autre d'inventé.

translation.title: Get in touch.
translation.body: The simplest way is the contact form: describe one concrete problem, and we will reply with what is feasible and where to start.

translation.title: Let's talk about your first case.
translation.text: Describe a concrete problem. We will tell you what is feasible, in which mode, and where to start.
